title: chaetobromus involucratus subsp. dregeanus
intro: Chaetobromus involucratus subsp. dregeanus, commonly known as Drege's chaetobromus, is a plant species within the family Poaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties that help alleviate symptoms of fever, respiratory issues, and digestive problems. The therapeutic actions of Chaetobromus involucratus subsp. dregeanus include its ability to reduce inflammation, soothe coughs, and treat wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
